name: nonprofits
install:
set -euo pipefail
NODE_VERSION=24.22.1
NODE_SHA256=6c172a9ab6718f7b801fb5a7bd486af2ee5e32758086a04b84fcce2aa77095e6
PNPM_VERSION=12.4.2
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then as_root() { "$@"; }; else as_root() { sudo "$@"; }; fi
if ! /usr/local/bin/node --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "v${NODE_VERSION}"; then
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.xz" -o "$tmp"
  echo "${NODE_SHA256}  ${tmp}" | sha256sum -c -
  as_root tar -xJf "$tmp" -C /usr/local --strip-components=1
  rm -f "$tmp"
fi
# later shells start from the agent's own PATH, where nvm's or the image's node comes first,
# so ~/.bashrc and the login file each end with a line putting /usr/local/bin back in front.
start_path=$PATH
login_rc=$HOME/.profile
for f in "$HOME/.bash_profile" "$HOME/.bash_login"; do [ -f "$f" ] && { login_rc=$f; break; }; done
pin='export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH" # node pin: .cursor/environment.json'
for rc in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$login_rc"; do
  touch "$rc"
  rest=$(grep -vxF "$pin" "$rc" || true)
  printf '%s\n%s\n' "$rest" "$pin" > "$rc"
done
for mode in -lc -ic; do
  got=$(env PATH="$start_path" bash "$mode" 'node --version' </dev/null 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)
  [ "$got" = "v${NODE_VERSION}" ] || { echo "a new 'bash $mode' runs node '${got}', not v${NODE_VERSION}" >&2; exit 1; }
done
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"
hash -r
export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0
as_root corepack enable
corepack prepare "pnpm@${PNPM_VERSION}" --activate
node --version | grep -qx "v${NODE_VERSION}"
pnpm --version | grep -qx "${PNPM_VERSION}"
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
